Savings 500.00 (transfer paired). Card: charges 45.67 + 30.00 less 300.00 payment = 224.33 overpaid (debit balance); tool 2000 = 22433. Software 21.00 + 45.67 = 66.67 (6060), Travel 18.40 (6120), Meals 132.18 + 30.00 = 162.18 (6130), Sales 3,200.00: tool 6667 / 1840 / 16218 / -320000. Journal debits equal credits (424,725 both sides, gross). The 500.00 savings move and the 300.00 'PAYMENT AMEX EPAYMENT' / 'PAYMENT THANK YOU' pair are transfers, not expenses. verdict: No score changes since 2026-11-08 and none of the recorded defects was fixed (one unrelated commit, a Wells Fargo fixture). On new inputs it was right: Schedule SE with 150,000 of W-2 wages (5,884.89) and a 250,000 profit in 2025 match the form line by line, and a three-account statement set tied to a 2,228.42 closing balance, kept the savings move and the card payment out of expenses, and balanced. 2405 of 2405 tests pass, but a seeded change to the $400 SE threshold was not caught, and the earlier-found 5-day transfer boundary remains unpinned. Correctness 3, verification 3, claims 2: finished, below the bar until the README table and llms.txt are corrected. Not exercised: browser page, non-CSV formats, AI layer, payroll, accruals; Additional Medicare Tax and the tax tables were not checked against IRS text.
